summary.intent: Address a review finding (trail finding 01M6T6QNY4G4) on the feat/release-pr-headlines branch: the release PR change title rendered inside an HTML summary lost text such as Vec<T> because markdown isn't interpreted there.
summary.outcome: Edited pr_body.rs so code spans in the summary title become code elements and the remaining text is HTML-escaped. fmt, clippy, doc and lib tests were run, and the fix was committed, pushed, and the finding resolved with a note citing the test a_summary_title_keeps_code_spans_and_escapes_the_rest.

repo: Release PR bodies are built in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/pr_body.rs, and change titles placed in raw-HTML summary elements must be converted manually because markdown is not rendered there.

Pre-commit checks for this repo are cargo fmt, cargo clippy -p callisto-graph -p callisto-cli --all-targets -D warnings, cargo doc --no-deps --workspace with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings, and cargo test -p callisto-graph --lib.
Work happens in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/macos-15-runners while the branch being pushed is feat/release-pr-headlines.

code.finding: Summary title rendering now converts backtick code spans to code elements and HTML-escapes the rest, so generic types like Vec<T> are preserved. Exact line numbers were not shown in the transcript.

workflow: The entire CLI supports listing findings on a branch (entire trail finding <n> --branch), showing one by id, and resolving it with -m to record the fix.
Commit with the full /usr/bin/git path and commit.gpgsign=false, then push and resolve the finding in the same command chain.
Piping tool output through tail/head keeps check results brief, but only the last line of each check is seen.

friction: Check output was truncated to the last line, so failures earlier in the output could be missed.
The final git status and log output were not shown, so the push result is not confirmed in the transcript.
